minor.issue: HEAD returns 405 Method Not Allowed. GET works fine (200 application/pdf). Non-blocking — no client actually needs HEAD.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab click reliability: playwright .click(force=True) on [data-testid=plans-tab-memberships] sometimes fails to switch tabs when 'What's New' modal was recently dismissed or when a debug overlay is present. Direct DOM .click() via evaluate works reliably. Suggests React onClick may be bound via delegation and initial pointer events get eaten. Real users clicking after modal dismissal should be fine but worth spot-checking with slower devices.

integration_issues.issue: Buyer name from public form ('QA Member') is overridden by an existing customer record matched via phone (came out as 'Alice Tester'). If intentional, fine; if not, /api/premium-membership/upi-paid should trust the entered name OR create a new customer instead of matching by phone.

issues: Persistent hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — from visual-editor spans injected into <option>. Pre-existing, non-blocking (also noted in iteration 97).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Membership tab click on /plans is flaky under Playwright when What's-New modal is present. Reliable pattern: (1) set localStorage.miracurl_tenant, (2) log in and dismiss 'Got it' modal, (3) navigate /plans, (4) dismiss 'Got it' if it reappears, (5) use page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"plans-tab-memberships\"]').click()") to switch tabs, (6) then use .click() or .evaluate() on approve buttons. Approve endpoint = POST /api/premium-membership/orders/{orderId}/approve. Public member endpoints require X-Tenant-Slug header (or the URL contains the tenant slug for /membership/{slug}/config). New members created this iteration: MC-ZVHM-GS39-XNFP (Gold, Alice Tester).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing feature detected. Two non-critical observations: (a) HEAD on card.pdf returns 405 (FastAPI route only registers GET, uvicorn's default HEAD support fell back). (b) Buyer name replaced by existing customer name when phone matches — happens in premium_membership activation code path (upi-paid or approve likely looks up existing customer by phone_e164 and reuses that customer's name).
